ambiguities.text: The LightClientStore upgrade MAY be performed before ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations should upgrade proactively when possible but are not required to. The MAY indicates optional early upgrade for smoother transition.

ambiguities.text: No explicit description of what happens if a merkle branch is already at or exceeds the required Electra depth
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume normalize_merkle_branch only pads if current depth is less than required; if equal or greater, no modification needed. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: The generalized indices used for Electra are correct and correspond to the actual SSZ tree structure of Electra beacon state
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect generalized indices would produce invalid merkle proofs, causing light clients to reject valid updates or accept invalid ones

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes will eventually upgrade to Electra and the network format for pre-fork data will remain available during the transition period
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Light clients could become unable to sync if pre-fork format data is no longer served before they complete the upgrade
